segments.text: Empty motorway. Just you and the crash barrier. Then the crash barrier starts to wobble.
It jumps off its posts. And stretches right across the road. Like a giant rubber band. What do you do?
Most drivers think: full speed! Just break right through it!
But it doesn't break. It stretches. Further. And further. And further.
Then it snaps back. And you fly backwards, like a slingshot. Over two fields. Head first into a haystack.
Here's how you do it properly.
Stop. Hazard lights on. And wait.
The barrier is just bored. Twenty years of standing still. It wants to play.
So, turn up the radio. And it starts to swing. Like a giant skipping rope.
Now hop over it. One car at a time. Hop. Hop. Hop.
Then it lies back down on its posts. Happy. And straighter than ever.
Next exam question: a wall of fog. And out of it ride knights. Follow, so you don't miss it.
